result.rationale: These statements explicitly invoke relativistic Doppler/aberration from a relative-velocity rest frame (Eq.4-5, covariant velocity argument, aberration-based solid angle and beaming corrections, CMB aberration), directly embodying the false assumption that galaxies occupy a distinct kinematic frame from the observer rather than being comoving in an expanding spacetime.

The annotation targets the false assumption that galaxies are in a different reference frame than the observer, invalidating the setup. The system instead flags isolated algebraic/sign errors (missing 1+z, wrong solid-angle sign, index-lowering misuse, etc.), not this foundational frame error.
